D.treatment: ESL support in high school, 750 contact hours

O.outcome_detail: reaching the estimated threshold for postsecondary study

cells.quote: Nevertheless, most ESL learners can benefit from ESL support in high school (750 contact hours can have a tangible effect) to reach the estimated threshold for postsecondary school studies, whether university or technical school.
cells.note: The study presents this as an assertion from the author's program of work, but reports no comparison group, study design, sample, statistical result, or effect size.
